Calculation.Text: /* _fmIDEGetVersionFromScript Returns the versions number from the last word of the script starting with ###. 20260909 @mrwatson-de v0.1 */ Let([ pAppChangesScriptNameStub = "###" ; vScriptNames = ScriptNames ( Get( FileName ) ) ; vAppChangesScriptNumber = ValueCount( Left( vScriptNames ; Position( ¶ & vScriptNames ; ¶ & pAppChangesScriptNameStub ; 1 ; 1 ) ) ) ; vAppChangesScriptName = GetValue( vScriptNames ; vAppChangesScriptNumber ) ; vAppChangesVersionString = Trim( Substitute( Middle( vAppChangesScriptName ; Length( pAppChangesScriptNameStub ) +1 ; 999 ) ; "#" ; "" ) ) ; vAppChangesVersionShort = RightWords( vAppChangesVersionString ; 1 ) ]; vAppChangesVersionShort )
